Player, no artwork. After tapping download on «محمود خليل الحصري»: that row shows the progress bar (player colours) and a 44 pt stop button. Caption annotation: «يبدأ التشغيل تلقائيًا عند انتهاء التنزيل» (when the download finishes, the player switches to that reciter and auto-plays from the current ayah). Switching reciter keeps the place: same surah, start of the current ayah, new reciter timings, play or pause state and repeat kept; no timings («بدون تتبع») starts the surah from the beginning (ADR 0062 decision 6). Approved 4 Nov 2026 (ADR 0062)

Player, no artwork (ADR 0062 option b). Reciter name, surah, ayah card, progress, transport and the utility bar (repeat, ayah range, sleep timer; speed removed). Reciters list always visible under the controls: current reciter selected (checkmark); installed row is a button that switches reciter; not-downloaded row has a 44 pt download button; a reciter without the current surah (37) is disabled with «غير متوفرة لهذه السورة». Switching reciter keeps the place: same surah, start of the current ayah, new reciter timings, play or pause state and repeat kept; no timings («بدون تتبع») starts the surah from the beginning (ADR 0062 decision 6). Approved 4 Nov 2026 (ADR 0062)

Mini player, playing · continuous play skipped surah 37 (moved 36 → 38). Shows surah ص playing normally, plus a secondary line «تخطّي الصافات · غير متوفرة بصوت إسلام صبحي». The notice is transient: it shows for about 4 s, then the line disappears. VoiceOver announces it (role=status, polite). Approved 4 Nov 2026 (ADR 0062)

Reading · mini player, surah unavailable for the reciter (surah 37 الصافات with إسلام صبحي; play was pressed, nothing plays, no progress state). Info glyph and message; «تغيير القارئ» opens the reciter picker (44 pt target). Idle reader rule (ADR 0059) so the bar stays on the reader. Approved 4 Nov 2026 (ADR 0062)
اتجاه القبلة · القرص ثابت والإبرة تتبع القبلة (ADR 0049)

Listen › إسلام صبحي · surah list, rows 35–41 (same row styling as SurahIndex; header as Reciters). Surahs 37 الصافات, 39 الزمر and 40 غافر are missing from this reciter: dimmed (ink-muted), trailing label «غير متوفرة» instead of the play or download control, not tappable (no link, aria-disabled). Others are normal. Approved 4 Nov 2026 (ADR 0062)
